summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh GitHub releases into a temporary directory, unzips it, chmods it to 0o755, and executes a sibling file math_init.js under that freshly downloaded Bun binary via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, Bun-compiled ('// @bun @bun-cjs' header) file with rotated string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotator function, hex-numbered _0x-style identifiers). The payload is reachable only through the preinstall Bun-dropper chain and is unrelated to the package's advertised React date-picker functionality. The package name places this under the @ornikar scope while its README is copied verbatim from the unrelated upstream Kiarash-Z/react-modern-calendar-datepicker project, which ships no such install script or math_init.js. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated sibling script is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: it runs attacker-controlled code inside npm install and evades Node-based static and dynamic analysis by running the payload under Bun.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
